project_type: Full-stack SaaS Educational Management System (Node.js/Express + React/Next.js + PostgreSQL/Prisma)
build_system: npm with tsc for backend, Next.js build for frontend
verification_instructions:
1. Run npm run build in /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/saas-educacional
2. Run npm test to verify all tests pass
3. Verify Prisma schema validates with npx prisma validate
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client generated files (node_modules/.prisma/client). Regenerate with: npx prisma generate
setup_instructions:
1. cd /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/saas-educacional
2. npm install
3. npx prisma generate
4. npm run build
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. Node.js v22 available. PostgreSQL is NOT pre-installed but Prisma schema can be generated and validated.
contribution_requirements: Project must be at /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/saas-educacional/ as specified by the user.
key_patterns: Monorepo-like structure with both backend and frontend in the same directory. Express.js REST API backend at src/backend/. Next.js React frontend at src/frontend/. Prisma ORM at prisma/. JWT auth with refresh tokens. Multi-tenant architecture.
directory_structure:
/projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/saas-educacional/ - Target SaaS application root
  /prisma/ - Prisma schema and migrations
  /src/backend/ - Express.js API (server, routes, controllers, services, middleware)
  /src/frontend/ - Next.js React app (App Router, Tailwind, components)
